title: Vui lòng gửi nó đến khách sạn này
englishTitle: Please send it to this hotel
pronunciation: Vui long gui no den khach san nay
summary: Please send it to this hotel

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Vui lòng gửi nó đến khách sạn này works before the exchange needs a longer explanation.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Vui lòng gửi nó đến khách sạn này in one clean pass; the passport, baggage tag, flight detail, or pickup screen can carry the detail.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Practice Vui lòng gửi + nó đến khách first; the full line keeps the request from sounding chopped up.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the exchange continues, where is immigration?; where is baggage claim?; where can I buy a SIM card? can carry the next detail.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: At an airport counter, baggage area, or pickup point, keep the passport, baggage tag, flight detail, or pickup screen visible while the first answer comes back.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Airport staff and drivers are used to short, practical questions. Keep the document or phone screen visible so they can answer quickly.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Keep close by: Where is the pickup area, Where do I meet the driver, and My bag did not arrive.
